summary: Vaxcyte, Inc. filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (424B5) for a registered public offering of common stock and, for certain investors, pre-funded warrants priced at the share price minus $0.001 with a $0.001 exercise price. No share count, offering size, or price is stated; the last reported Nasdaq price on October 5, 2026 was $73.82. A concurrent private offering of convertible senior notes due 2032 is proceeding separately, neither contingent on the other, with underwriters holding a 30-day option. Proceeds fund general corporate purposes; no board recommendation or advisor opinion is given. Routine capital raise, not a special situation; watch pricing, dilution and note terms.
